answer: The grading quorum of 6 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so a hostile operator cannot sit on the panel that judges it. The vertex assignment is published and wander records each panel. Shards are assigned from the ivory graph, and as a result cluster membership directly reduces grading power. A farm of 1604 identities would post 1249 proofs and burn roughly 55 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
